yamlCheck.dateAnchor: Spoken December 18 afternoon, December 20, corrected December 21 arrival, and December 22. Year and opening working date derive from YAML; later dates are conditional on narrated transitions. Session 82 u0113–u0115 retrospectively dates a post-destruction departure from Pyhlla to December 25; u0118–u0119 identifies the preceding scepter and Vetta victories.
yamlCheck.explanation: The December 22 fights, ensuing overnight to December 23, salvage montage, next-day bath and twenty-four-hour vigil can fit December 17–25. The “most of the next day” salvage summary can also imply an extra day, ending December 26. No exact total is established; historical mirror scenes do not extend the adventure span. The adjacent registered transcript’s December 25 departure after destruction favors the December 25 closing reading and competes with a literal extra-day reading of the local montage; the local ambiguity is retained for human resolution, not filled with an assumed day.

boundaryUncertainties.reading: Whether the salvage summary repeats December 23 or advances to December 24 affects the vigil’s end. Session 82’s explicitly dated December 25 departure after the destruction supplies an upper bound, favoring December 25 over the local-only December 26 alternative.

alternatives.reading: If salvage summarizes December 23, the bath begins December 24 and ends December 25.
If salvage advances to December 24, the next-day bath begins December 25 and ends December 26. This local-only reading conflicts with the later December 25 post-destruction departure in session 82.
